This document outlines the 
equipment inspection check list I1, which must be performed on a year bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block

The technical specification of the breaker: Rated current 600 A, 33 kv, 500 
MVA, 8.75 kA

The 
first draft is initiated and reviewed by eng. Nagy Bekheit Saleh,
accepted by eng. Badr Ibrahem Abdel Gawad 
general director, and approved by eng. Abdel Karem Abu Zied Ismaiel; Head Sector 
of High Dam Hydraulic Power Station, Hyd.EPCo.

This document 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.

A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable category
Switch off the CB, the isolating disconnecting switch

items:
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ..etc
Switch off the CB, the isolating disconnecting switch
Tool set and cleaning materials (cloth - benzene)

Drain off the oil, remove lower covers, with stationary 
 contacts and take out explosion chambers spacing cylinders

Repair contacts and chamber, examine and clean other parts of 
 the breaker

Clean the damaged places in the fixed contacts, wash them by 
 benzene and wipe them dry
Replace badly burned contacts with large pits
Inspect and clean all insulating parts
Check and clean the spring damper and then lubricate it
Check and tightening all the breaker fastenings
Inspects and cleans the moving contacts

Check the CB adjustment. Travel inside the contacts, total 
 travel of the moving contacts, difference between the contact rod extreme and 
 working positions

Check the operation of the CB mechanism connected with the 
 operating mechanism at smooth operation

Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection check list I1, which must be performed on a year bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block
The technical specification of the breaker: Rated current 600 A, 33 kv, 500 
MVA, 8.75 kA
The

This document 
certified by eng. Kamel Ragheb Hakem MPIS Hyd.EPCo.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable category
Switch off the CB, the isolating disconnecting switch
Switch of the DC current.
A work permit must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable category
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear safety and healthy equipments as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes ..etc
Switch off the CB, the isolating disconnecting switch
Switch of the DC current.
Tools and Equipment
Tool set and cleaning materials (cloth - benzene)
Oil for lubbricating
Work to be Carried Out
Drain off the oil, remove lower covers, with stationary 
 contacts and take out explosion chambers spacing cylinders
Repair contacts and chamber, examine and clean other parts of 
 the breaker
Clean the damaged places in the fixed contacts, wash them by 
 benzene and wipe them dry
Replace badly burned contacts with large pits
Inspect and clean all insulating parts
Check and clean the spring damper and then lubricate it
Check and tightening all the breaker fastenings
Inspects and cleans the moving contacts
Lubricate the CB mechanism
Check the CB adjustment. Travel inside the contacts, total 
 travel of the moving contacts, difference between the contact rod extreme and 
 working positions
Check the operation of the CB mechanism connected with the 
 operating mechanism at smooth operation
